note:
1921 Derby Terrace, read from the householders' schedules supplied by A. Hagues on 27 September 2026.

Three of the five sent are here. Schedule 57 places itself: Lois Hetty Wing, the fourteen-year-old
domestic servant, gives her place of work as "3 Derby Terrace", which is the house she lives in.

Two are held back. Schedules 56 and 55 also place themselves, by Derby Road number rather than Derby
Terrace number - their servants give 153 and 151 Derby Road - and those do not agree with the Derby
Terrace numbers supplied. The record maps 153 Derby Road to 5 Derby Terrace and 151 to 6, where the
numbers given were 4 and 7. Until that is settled neither household is filed.
source: 1921 census - Derby Terrace, schedules 53, 57 and 58, transcribed by A. Hagues.
